## Summary

Senior Full Stack AI Engineer with 5+ years building AI-driven SaaS products, automation pipelines,
voice agents, and serverless cloud systems. End-to-end ownership across frontend (React, Next.js),
backend (NestJS, Node.js), DevOps (AWS Lambda, SST, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions), and AI
integrations (OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, RAG, OCR, voice agents). Delivered production systems for
US and European clients — dynamic LLM architectures, AI voice agents, CRM automations, and serverless
cloud deployments. Comfortable working directly with founders and non-technical stakeholders.
